Name: (FS) MeowMeow's Clothing - Walnut
Author: meowmeow233
Description:
[b]About This Mod

[/b]It adds an outfit including hairstyles, hats, shirts, skirts, and sleeves. You can wear them as a complete outfit or mix and match with other clothing.
It is my first mod, and I am excited to release it! (^u^) The outfit is inspired by my previously designed oc named Walnut.
Thanks for using it!

[b]Required Mods[/b]

It requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] to be installed.

[b]How To Use[/b]

[list=1]
[*]﻿Download the file and put it into the Mods folder before launching the game
[*]Obtain the hand mirror by purchasing from Pierre or selecting "Start with Mirror" when creating a new file
[*]Right-click to use the hand mirror, then click the arrow to pick your clothes.

[/list]
